# Alpha

> **Alpha** — An autonomous AI agent framework with sandboxed execution, persistent memory, subagent delegation, and extensible tooling. Built for autonomous operations at scale.

## Quick Links

- [Website](https://alpha.itsPremkumar.com)
- [Documentation](https://docs.alpha.itsPremkumar.com)
- [API Reference](https://docs.alpha.itsPremkumar.com/api/)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/itsPremkumar/alpha)
- [Discord](https://discord.gg/alpha)

## Project Description

Alpha is a LangGraph-based AI super-agent system — a backend "super agent" with sandboxed execution, persistent memory, subagent delegation, and extensible tooling (built-in, MCP, community), all per-thread isolated; a Next.js chat frontend; and IM bridges (Feishu, Slack, Telegram, Discord, DingTalk) into the same agent through the Gateway.

## Key Capabilities

- **Super Agent**: LangGraph-based orchestrator with tool calling, model routing, and autonomous execution
- **Keyless model routing**: `alpha-free` discovers configured public gateways, uses bounded concurrent health probes, and fails over without promising anonymous-provider availability
- **Sandboxed Execution**: Isolated environments (Docker, AIO, E2B, local) per thread with file I/O, network, and process isolation
- **Persistent Memory**: owner-scoped memory with heuristic secret redaction before L1 record IDs are created, fail-closed writes, explicit refusal when memory-fabric data uses an unsupported future schema, optional deterministic task-aware recall, and default-off codebase structure memory that indexes only a trusted internal workspace root and recalls query-matched symbols/dependencies without injecting source text ([memory guide](https://github.com/itsPremkumar/alpha/blob/main/docs/MEMORY.md))
- **Subagent Delegation**: Spawn bounded specialists; chat progress cards show status, readable latest step/tool-call summaries, reported steps and measured usage. The [Workforce guide](https://github.com/itsPremkumar/alpha/blob/main/docs/WORKFORCE.md) explains when to use subagents, swarm topologies, Arena counts, and how their limits differ
- **Bot Forge + online Skills Hub**: Search the live skills.sh catalog, inspect public GitHub skill packages at immutable source identities, review findings, and install the exact digest through Alpha's user-scoped scanners; then forge a specialist with a tailored SOUL and verify a Bot-scoped task. Popularity is not a safety guarantee; unprobed builds remain unverified.
- **Arena Tournaments**: N sub-agents solve one task with distinct strategy cards, then attack, defend, and judge in a durable single-elimination bracket until one solution survives
- **Group-Relative Orchestration (GRO)**: A bounded group of candidate attempts executed under distinct strategies, selected by absolute acceptance gates first (relative rank only ranks the eligible; `unknown` is never a pass) with one bounded repair round and an explicit UNVERIFIED partial result when nothing passes - default off behind `gro.enabled`, driven by the `swarm` tool's `compete`/`compete_status` actions
- **Capability Mesh**: Evidence-backed capability records for every dispatchable configuration, with every count reported beside its evidence level (`unmeasured` reads as `unmeasured`) - `capability_mesh` tool (12 actions, one write) and `/api/capability-mesh`; off by default behind `capability_mesh.enabled`, and a read/preview plane that dispatches nothing even when enabled
- **Extensible Tooling**: 139 built-in tools, 49 middleware modules + MCP servers + custom skills + community extensions
- **Per-Thread Isolation**: Every conversation gets its own sandbox, memory, and tool namespace
- **Run acceptance API**: Measures exact-text/artifact readbacks and the exact `Auto-detected project test suite passes.` criterion from a correlated, auto-detected `auto_test_and_repair` result; caller-supplied test commands and unsupported criteria remain unverified
- **Project guidance**: Owner-scoped instructions for an assigned project are loaded on each run as hidden, request-only user-level guidance; they cannot grant tools or override system/safety policy
- **IM Bridges**: Native Feishu, Slack, Telegram, Discord, DingTalk connectors via unified Gateway
- **Observability**: Real-time SSE streams, run traces, token usage, cost tracking, delivery receipts
- **Governance**: Tool risk policies, approval gates, capability ceilings, emergency stop
- **Durable Runtime**: Crash recovery, network partitions, graceful shutdown, session persistence
- **Autonomous command receipts**: Natural-language lifecycle matches show the Gateway's execution status and returned output in the chat; detection alone is not shown as a completed action
- **APEX Autopilot**: Dispatches objectives through RunManager; completion requires evidence for every criterion. The UI applies editable finite per-session defaults (100,000 tokens, 200 tool calls, 60 minutes); expanded session history shows those ceilings beside usage, and one in-flight model call can exceed the token ceiling. Registered probes and the shared run verifier can automatically measure exact-text/artifact readbacks and the typed auto-detected project-test criterion; supplied commands and arbitrary criteria remain unverified until a supported collector or owner evidence covers them.
- **Conversation goal completion**: The bounded goal loop evaluates visible chat plus persisted successful tool receipts, while treating tool output as untrusted data; this model judgment is separate from measured APEX acceptance verification.
- **Alpha-to-Alpha peer network**: Pair installations with single-use invites shown as QR codes and scanned locally from a camera or image; the peer network is disabled by default.

## Key Commands

The slash-command catalog is larger than the executable surface: of the commands listed below, only `/goal` (with its subcommands) has a bound handler today. The other 13 rows are catalogued in `alpha.commands.registry` but answer `status="unimplemented"` with "nothing was executed" — catalog membership is product direction, never an available API.

- `/goal` - Define and orchestrate autonomous goals
- `/plan` - Compile 8-dimensional strategic meta-plan
- `/swarm` - Orchestrate multi-agent specialized swarms
- `/agent` - Spawn, inspect, or manage autonomous agents
- `/research` - Deep multi-stage web and codebase research
- `/code` - Inspect, write, and refactor code modules
- `/memory` - Query and store episodic and semantic memory
- `/verify` - Verify current result against requirements
- `/context` - Shows current context composition and usage
- `/model` - Shows or changes active model
- `/reasoning` - Shows or changes reasoning effort
- `/tools` - Shows currently available tools and their status
- `/skills` - Shows installed, available and active skills
- `/trace` - Shows execution trace for current mission

## Technology Stack

- **Backend**: Python 3.12+, FastAPI, LangGraph, uv
- **Frontend**: Next.js 15, React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- **Database**: PostgreSQL, SQLite, Redis
- **Infrastructure**: Docker, nginx, Kubernetes
- **Orchestration**: LangGraph, LangChain
- **Memory**: DeerMem, cognitive memory
